'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Operation Muhafiz-ul-Bahr]]
*****A [[Pakistan]]-bound [[oil tanker]] with its [[Automatic Identification System]] activated, the ''Karachi'', gets safe passage and crosses the [[Strait of Hormuz]] following negotiations between the [[Government of Pakistan|Pakistani]] and [[Government of Iran|Iranian governments]].  According to [[Senate of Pakistan|Senator]] [[Mushahid Hussain Sayed]], Pakistan agreed to pay the oil shipment, purchased from [[Abu Dhabi]], in Chinese yuan instead of in US dollars. [https://english.aaj.tv/news/330455029/pakistan-tanker-crosses-hormuz-after-oil-payment-made-in-chinese-yuan-mushahid (AAJ News)]
****Several [[NATO]] allies of the [[United States]], including [[Germany]], [[Italy]], and [[Spain]], rule out sending warships to lift the [[blockade]] of the [[Strait of Hormuz]] following a request from [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/us-allies-rebuff-trumps-request-support-strait-hormuz-2026-03-16/ (Reuters)]
****[[Australia]] rules out sending warships to lift the [[blockade]] of the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.9news.com.au/world/us-israel-iran-war-live-updates-trump-netanyahu-how-long-will-the-war-last/3a066ef3-fe97-4b15-8222-982b2e91de3f (Nine News Australia)]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] says that [[Iran]] is not seeking a [[ceasefire]] but also called for the [[war]] to end. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202603166219 (Iran International)]
***[[United Arab Emirates in the 2026 Iran war|2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
****[[Iran]] launches [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone attacks]] on the [[United Arab Emirates]], killing a [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man in [[Abu Dhabi]] and forcing the temporary closure of [[Dubai International Airport]]. The [[port of Fujairah]], in the [[Emirate of Fujairah]], already attacked two days ago, is also hit.  [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/03/16/iranian-drone-attack-dubai-international-airport/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crl4gxgkkylo (BBC)]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes and completely destroys the [[Iranian Space Research Center]] in central [[Tehran]], stating that it was being used for potential [[space warfare]] activities against [[Israel]]i [[satellite]]s. [https://iranwire.com/en/news/150520-israeli-army-announces-destruction-of-a-military-space-center-in-tehran/ (Iran Wire)]
***[[Kata'ib Hezbollah]] senior commander Abu Ali al-Askari is killed in an airstrike in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-890170 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
***The [[Embassy of the United States, Baghdad|U.S. embassy]] in Baghdad is reportedly attacked by two [[Drone warfare|suicide drones]], causing a powerful explosion. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/lizrds8gt (Ynet)]
***The [[Royal Tulip Al Rasheed Hotel]] in the [[Green Zone]] in Baghdad is struck by a drone. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/16/hotel-in-iraqi-capital-baghdad-struck-as-attacks-on-us-embassy-intercepted (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****At least seven people, including four children, are injured by [[Hezbollah]] rocket and drone attacks on [[northern Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-begins-targeted-ground-operation-to-expand-south-lebanon-buffer-against-hezbollah/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-890098 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
****The [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]]'s [[91st Division (Israel)|91st Division]] launches a ground operation against [[Hezbollah]] in [[southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]], expanding a [[buffer zone]] along [[Israel–Lebanon barrier|the border]]. [https://www.israelhayom.com/2026/03/16/idf-ground-operation-southern-lebanon-hezbollah-division-91/ (''Israel Hayom'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/troops-have-moved-deeper-into-lebanon-to-create-buffer-against-hezbollah-idf-says/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**At least four members of [[Iraq]]'s [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] (PMF) are killed and three others are injured in an [[airstrike]] on a checkpoint at the entrance to [[Al-Qa'im (town)|Al-Qa'im]], [[Al Anbar Governorate]]. A PMF official attributes the strike to the [[United States Armed Forces|United States]]. [https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/middleeastnews/915097/strike-kills-at-least-four-iraqi-fighters-near-syria-border-security-s/en (AFP via LBCI)]

*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**[[2026 Kabul hospital airstrike]]
***[[Afghanistan]] claims [[Pakistan Air Force|Pakistani jets]] bombed a [[drug rehabilitation]] centre in [[Kabul]], killing over 400 people. [[Pakistan]] denies the claim, saying it attacked military installations. [[Agence France-Presse|AFP]] and [[BBC News|BBC]] journalists confirm at least 30 dead as a result of the bombing. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4g8n7e0l40o (BBC News)]  [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/03/16/afghanistan-pakistan-border-clashes-children-killed-taliban/ab85acd4-213e-11f1-954a-6300919c9854_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2026 Maiduguri bombings]]
**At least 23 people are killed and 108 others are injured in suspected [[Suicide attack|suicide bombings]] at three locations, including the [[Monday Market]] and [[University of Maiduguri Teaching Hospital]], in [[Maiduguri]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. No group has claimed responsibility. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-triple-suicide-attacks-kill-least-23-nigerias-maiduguri-2026-03-17/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-bombings-boko-haram-borno-maiduguri-2256cebae89370b21930b006c5aa6f6e (AP)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]], [[kidnapping in Nigeria]]
**One person is killed and seven others are abducted, including children, in an attack on a community in [[Chikun]], [[Kaduna State]], Nigeria. [https://punchng.com/gunmen-kill-deaf-man-abduct-seven-in-kaduna-community/ (''The Punch'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Vaccination policy of the United States]]
**[[United States]] [[United States federal judge|federal judge]] [[Brian E. Murphy]] blocks the implementation of changes to vaccine policy introduced by [[United States Secretary of Health and Human Services|health and human services secretary]] [[Robert F. Kennedy Jr.]], including revisions to the [[Childhood immunizations in the United States|childhood immunization]] schedule and recommendations issued by the [[Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices]]. Murphy rules that the measures likely violate required procedures and halts their enforcement pending further legal proceedings. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260316-us-judge-halts-implementation-of-trump-vaccine-overhaul (AFP via France 24)]
*The death toll from [[Lassa fever]] in [[Nigeria]] this year rises to 109. [https://punchng.com/lassa-fever-bauchi-ondo-hardest-hit-death-toll-now-109/ (''The Punch'')]
*A woman is killed and over 100 others are hospitalized after getting [[foodborne illness]] at a [[pizzeria]] in [[Pombal, Paraíba|Pombal]], [[Paraíba]], [[Brazil]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260318/ad75bde5cc2246ce9946155109dc75a8/c.html (Xinhua)]
